facts.fact: Mmegi reports the Bank of Botswana said its amendments to the Electronic Payment Services (EPS) regulations came into effect on 2 April 2026, and that under the regulations operating an EPS without a Bank licence carries a P1 million fine and or five years' imprisonment.

note: The article says the amendments clarify which entities may be licensed to offer EPS but does not state that non-banks are licensed, so no reach fact; no connection rule is mentioned.
